edition.notes: The Holy See archive file is a typeset text transcription of the volume and carries no page images, so image collation is not possible by that route. Two evident defects affect this act: the second correlative of tum...tum is printed 'cum', and the saving clause is printed 'Beconciliatricis' for Reconciliatricis. The volume's own analytical index confirms the locus at 'Dec. 21 Decretum circa vulgo dictum «Secret de la Salette». 594'. Exact file bytes not retained in the repository.

alternate_titles: Holy Office decree of 21 December 1915 on the so-called Secret of La Salette
work.author: Suprema Sacra Congregatio Sancti Officii
work.description: The decree of the Supreme Sacred Congregation of the Holy Office, dated at Rome 21 December 1915 and subscribed by the notary Aloisius Castellano, recording that some persons, even from the ecclesiastical body, continued to publish books, pamphlets, and periodical articles discussing the so-called Secret de la Salette, its various forms, and its application to present or future times, without and even against the permission of the ordinaries; commanding all the faithful of whatever region not to discuss or treat of the said subject under any pretext or in any form; attaching penalties (for priests, deprivation of dignity and suspension by the local ordinary from confessions and from celebrating Mass; for lay persons, exclusion from the Sacraments until repentance; for both, the sanctions of Leo XIII's Officiorum ac munerum and of Urban VIII's decree of 13 March 1625 on circulating alleged revelations); and expressly preserving devotion to the Blessed Virgin under the title of Reconciliatrix commonly called de la Salette. Published in Acta Apostolicae Sedis 7 (1915), p. 594. Loci are the parts of the act.
work.title: Decretum circa vulgo dictum «Secret de la Salette»
